title: Plain style vs Greek scorn (Philoc. 15)
english: Against Greek philosophers who mock Scripture’s cheap diction and the simple in the churches: God chose what is [[foolish in the world to shame the wise >> Bible:1 Corinthians 1:27]]; power is in the message, not Attic dress.
